gaps.explanation: Detail has only the General Fund by-department schedule (p13, total revenues 1,183,484). The governmental funds statement (p4) prints five more fund columns with no schedule of their own: Keno 27,373 (Interest 64 + Other 27,309), Street 998,256 (City sales taxes 54,460 + Federal revenues 666,594 + State revenues 277,202), CDBG Housing Rehab 3,418 (Interest 79 + Other 3,339), ARPA 153,650 (Federal revenues 152,917 + Interest 733), Debt Service 169,293 (Property taxes 129,421 + Special assessments 19,261 + State revenues 20,611). 27,373 + 998,256 + 3,418 + 153,650 + 169,293 = 1,351,990; 1,183,484 + 1,351,990 = 2,535,474 = statement total. (Debt Service also prints 'Issuance of bonds' 855,000 under other financing sources on p4; it is debt proceeds, not a transfer, and has no gap row here, so it is not added.)

gaps.explanation: Statement p4 prints only 'Operating transfers in' 100,000 (General column; from the Electric Fund, p8 transfers out (100,000)). The General Fund by-department schedule p14 prints 'Operating transfers in (out)' per department: General (605,994), Fire 79,848, Police 305,372, Pool 54,592, Park 114,644, Summer Youth 10,765, Library 140,773, Totals 100,000. Detail records these as printed: Transfers In 79,848 + 305,372 + 54,592 + 114,644 + 10,765 + 140,773 = 705,994 and Transfers Out -605,994 (net 100,000 = statement). The 605,994 difference is intra-General-Fund department allocation that the fund-level statement does not show; the net ties exactly, so nothing is missing or duplicated.
